blocks.html: Where in situ Class 1a, 1b, or 1c rock is proposed for use in place of constructed methods of support, a subsurface investigation shall be conducted to assess the properties of the rock. Site-specific data shall be obtained to determine the predominant strike and dip of the joints, foliation, and/or other discontinuities in the rock. Recommendations for any rock stabilization necessary for the proposed work shall be provided.
